the check reads the words a closed reader returns for one case pattern list: a word whose syntax ends in an unquoted ) ends it and a leading ( opens it; a piece it cannot read as a literal word makes the branch run, which fails closed

the check reads a step's env value for the shape of one of two github context properties that differ from run to run, sha and event_name, and the step's text for any mention of the subject's name beyond an expansion
the check reads the subject word a closed reader returns after a case keyword, for one expansion of $1 or of a variable; any other subject leaves every branch running

the check reads the words a closed reader returns for a set or a shift: an option word of set that starts with - or + and takes a value after o, and a shift count; any other word changes $1, which makes every branch run
the check refuses a case pattern piece that holds a glob, quote, expansion or operator byte in the words a closed reader returns; a refused piece makes the branch run, which fails closed

the check reads an env name from a workflow's YAML map, upper-cased, for the names bash reads at startup to set options or import a function, PATH, and a ${{ expression that may spell any of them; a match moves the step, which only fails closed

the check reads one if value from a workflow's YAML, with its quoted strings and ${{ }} dropped, for a context name, a status function call, a failure() or cancelled() with no ! in front, and a bare false or 0 operand of &&; a match only drops wiring, so it fails closed

the check refuses a skipped argument word whose syntax, from a closed reader, holds an unquoted expansion, brace or pattern, or whose spelling holds an @; a refused word makes every branch run, which fails closed

the checks read a step's run text from a workflow's YAML for a ${{ expression, for a GITHUB_PATH name outside the lines laneToolLines blanks, and for a GITHUB_ENV write of a startup name; a match moves the step and every later one, which only fails closed

the checks read a case or esac word at one offset the flattener walks inside a substitution, and the words before it back over reserved words, time -p and a function name to the start of the frame or a separator; a case it reads as an argument leaves a frame that closes with a case and no esac after it, which makes the lane unreadable, so a misread fails closed

the check reads the command words a closed reader returns for a lone ( and ) and one $_ in the command after them; any other shape is no substitution, whose status the reader then does not let through, which only drops gating
the check reads the words of the command a closed reader returns after a substitution for one $_ and a plain assignment; any other shape masks the status, which only drops gating
the checks read the command words a closed reader returns past subshell parentheses, redirections and a wrapper; they parse words, not free text
the checks read the operand words of a set or shopt that a closed reader returns; an operand with an expansion turns errexit and pipefail off, which only drops gating
the check reads a step's run text for a name beyond a $NAME or ${NAME} expansion; any other mention makes the name not plain, which fails closed
the check reads one write target word a closed reader returns for a path in scripts/; a match unwires the step and every later one, which fails closed
the checks read the option words of one command a closed reader returns, to find the operands a write names; they parse words, not free text
the checks read the option words of one command a closed reader returns for the value of one option; they parse words, not free text

fails closed: a target variable that one line does not set, before any mention, to a literal path, a ${RUNNER_TEMP} path or a mktemp in it reads as unspelled, which unwires the step and every later one
fails closed: a write target word it cannot spell as a literal path, a runner file or a variable laneSetOnce reads unwires the step and every later one
the check reads a step's run text for GITHUB_ENV and the names githubEnvWrite reads; a match drops the case subjects and makes those names not plain, which fails closed
the check reads job and step if values from a workflow's YAML for event_name; a match drops the event subject, which fails closed
the pattern reads one write target word a closed reader returns as one expansion of a variable and a path under it; any other word is unspelled, which unwires the step and every later one

the pattern reads a step's run lines for the exact tool install forms of the release and security workflows after a sha256sum -c; any other line stays, so a GITHUB_PATH or RUNNER_TEMP bin mention in it unwires the later steps, which fails closed

the checks read a step's run lines for the exact tool install forms after a sha256sum -c and a cd, pushd or popd command a closed reader returns; any other line stays and unwires the later steps, which fails closed

the checks read a step's uses and with values from a workflow's YAML, its run text for a runner command or a mention of the RUNNER_TEMP bin, and the command words a closed reader returns for a cd; a match unwires the later steps, which fails closed
the checks read the words of one command a closed reader returns for a redirection operator, a descriptor copy and the options of the commands that write a file; they parse words, not free text

fails closed: the publish bridge reads a lane that names workcell_entry_root only at bytes it pins by sha256, which the reader of lint-ratchets-3i reads with the root pinned; other bytes are unreadable and a lane that does not name it is read as written; the merge of lint-ratchets-3i removes it

fails closed: for a lane the bridge read, the publish bridge reads a library only at bytes it pins by sha256, and other bytes are unreadable; a library of any other lane is read as written; the merge of lint-ratchets-3i removes it

reads only pinned bytes, which the reader of lint-ratchets-3i reads with the root pinned: it blanks the guard and its stop and writes the root line the bridge chose; the merge of lint-ratchets-3i removes it
